title: Last Day of the Rental Window on a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts Claim
content:
Rental days on a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts claim are counted to an end day. The end day turns on two records:
- the loaner agreement's return date, in the Courtesy Transportation Agreements records;
- the dates of the repair order's labor lines, in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

**The claim's covered concern line** is the one concern line of that repair order that carries its diagnostic fee, where exactly one does.

| Condition | End day |
|---|---|
| The loaner came back before the last labor line of the claim's covered concern line | the day the loaner came back |
| It did not, and that concern line's last labor line came before the repair order's last labor line | the day of that concern line's last labor line |
| Otherwise | the day of the repair order's last labor line |

Where no concern line, or more than one, carries the repair order's diagnostic fee, there is no covered concern line. The end day is then the day of the repair order's last labor line.

**Cases (hypothetical dates).**
- Covered line's last labor on the 12th, repair order's last labor on the 14th, loaner back on the 10th: end day the 10th.
- Same labor dates, loaner back on the 13th: end day the 12th.
- Covered line's last labor and repair order's last labor both on the 14th, loaner back on the 16th: end day the 14th.
- Loaner back on the 12th, the same day as the covered line's last labor, which is before the repair order's last labor on the 14th: the loaner did not come back before it, so the end day is the 12th.
